slug: 2025-06-27 Key Highlights of the Bank of Tanzania Financial Consumer Protection Amendment Regulations GN 298 of 2025

facts.fact: Kemi Advocates reports the Bank of Tanzania Financial Consumer Protection (Amendment) Regulations, GN No. 298 of 2025, dated 23 May 2025, apply to all financial service providers licensed or supervised by the BOT and set fee disclosure, fraud-loss refund and complaint-handling rules including for mobile money payments.

Kemi Advocates reports the regulations set maximum complaint resolution periods (12 hours for mobile money payments, 14 days for credit facilities) and let consumers escalate complaints to the Bank of Tanzania for review.
